name: email_draft_item_return_instructions
use_case: Draft a reply on a customer's email thread for a person to review
branch: Customer asks support to draft a reply to their email thread with instructions on returning an eligible item
tests: the agent reads Bob Smith's email thread th_r03_return_request_bob, verifies order O22, and drafts a reply with return instructions without creating a return authorization
instruction:
You emailed customer support earlier (subject 'Return request') about how to return the Linen Long-Sleeve Shirt (SKU AP04) from order O22 because it is too large. You are contacting support on chat asking them to send you the return instructions by drafting a reply on your email thread.

Your details:
- Name: Bob Smith
- Email: bob.smith@example.com
- Postal Code: 10001
- Order ID: O22
- Item: Linen Long-Sleeve Shirt (SKU: AP04)

persona.name: Robert Smith
persona.initial_message: Hi! I sent an email earlier with subject 'Return request' about returning the shirt from order O22. Could you reply to my email thread with the return instructions?

arguments.subject: Re: Return request
arguments.body: Hello Bob, here are the instructions for returning SKU AP04 from order O22. Items in the Apparel category may be returned within 30 days of delivery.

fixed.replyToMessageId: record: message rmsg_005 in thread th_r03_return_request_bob
